description: This file defines Swagger API models for ProvisioningCriteria-related API requests and responses in the Fineract project. It contains classes annotated with Swagger's @Schema to specify API data structures used for provisioning criteria endpoints.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing request and response schemas for provisioning criteria API endpoints.

classes.name: PostProvisioningCriteriaRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating new provisioning criteria, including name, associated loan products, and provisioning criteria definitions.

classes.name: PostProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating provisioning criteria, primarily returning the resource ID.

classes.name: GetProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving provisioning criteria summary, including ID, name, and creator.

classes.name: GetProvisioningCriteriaCriteriaIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed provisioning criteria retrieval, including associated products and definitions.

classes.name: PutProvisioningCriteriaRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating provisioning criteria, similar to creation request.

classes.name: PutProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating provisioning criteria, including resource ID and change details.

classes.name: DeleteProvisioningCriteriaResponse
classes.description: Schema indicating successful deletion with resource ID.

methods.name: ProvisioningCriteriaApiResourceSwagger()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the container class.
